author: UneCookie
body:
I'm very sad to say that I have been banned from the Avicus network. Despite the fact that by number of infractions I should be banned I feel that some of the infractions that have been given to me will be deemed unfairly given and/or false. For example, when staff, Awesomerp gave me an infraction for capitals after, over to messages in public chat, I said 4 words in capital letters (3 in the first message and 1 in the second) I also believe that one of these was,"LOL." This is an abbreviation, not a word...

Secondly, I have been given an infraction for, "swearing" I believe this was after the new rule was introduced, this infraction was given to me by alexanderjoe (I may be wrong in saying that this was given after the new rule was introduced and if it is I'm sorry to cause inconvenience to whoever has to check). And if Fouled was right with his estimate of around August/September time, then there may be numerous other ones however the one given by alexanderjoe was the most recent so I decided to use it in my appeal.

To conclude, I really, really hope this appeal is accepted because having to leave an awesome community like this would genuinely really upset me. With regards, Unequalz

P.S: If unbanned, I really have learnt my lesson and really try my best, despite my 'odd' personality some have understated, to not cause disruption and stay out of trouble.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

You have 20 infractions in 8 months, the last infraction was a joint tempban. This means that you were tempbanned for two reasons: posting inappropriate links and excessive infractions. As for the infractions that you are trying to appeal, I don't have access to check past logs. Your argument stating that "I have been given an infraction for swearing. I believe this was after the new rule was introduced" still does not allow you to get away with swearing. I'm not sure about the specifics about this, but I still feel as though you need to learn your lesson.

You may next create an appeal regarding this situation in 6-8 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Fouled
